observations.hierarchy: 'Launch checklist' leads clearly, but the page-list column competes: 'Project Atlas' title, a 170px boxed recovery notice, and 'Quick Notes' repeated as tab, section label and footer select; save state shown twice in green (header '● Saved to server' and meta 'Saved on server 7:17:50 PM').
observations.typography: Space throughout; 15px body in strong ink, restrained H2s, 13px meta and 14px nav; the footer notebook select renders in the browser's default sans (styles.css:6 'font: inherit' omits select).
observations.density_layout: Footer now one aligned 40px row (select, Indent, Outdent, Delete right) with Comments header above the fold; ~150px empty canvas band under the list and canvas text inset 33px from the title edge (stored coordinates, out of scope).

observations.visible_affordances: Search field border now reads at a glance; disabled 'Outdent page' is distinct from enabled 'Indent page'; selected notebook/page/tool unambiguous; header Save is the sole outlined save.
observations.coherence: Inline SVG nav icons unified; remaining strays: UA-font select, section tab with grey rounded top outline plus orange underline, bordered notice card with inner rail, and a rounded Comments card edge at the fold.

observations.palette_tokens: Chrome reads as ky-ui cream/charcoal; non-accent hues are semantic status only.
observations.type_geometry: 40px controls and 14px nav match; select falls out of Space; canvas text not on the title's left edge.

reviewer_spread.resolution: Re-inspected stage 03: UA-font select (typography), duplicate green save status plus four simultaneous selection markers (color), tab outline and boxed notice (coherence) are visible facts that keep each below 9. Each +1 comes from product change, not averaging.
Stage 02 settings nav had no current marker and clipped on phone; stage 03 fixes both, so the earlier gap is closed by the product.
Accent limited to selections; amber notice rail is semantic. 8 not 9 because tab underline, row rail and notice rail stack in one short viewport.
Mixed '+ New notebook' size fixed in stage 03; agreement reached via product change.

focus.evidence: No focus-ring captures in either theme.

contrast.evidence: --ky-field-border consumed only by .title-input, .personal-create, .editor-actions select, .note-search (styles.css:127,405,423). Settings/auth 'form input' (styles.css:79), .field select (103), .comment-compose input (146), .check-code-input (381) keep var(--line): Busnes light 1.57:1 on panel, dark 2.06:1 (alpha-blended from tokens.css:40/64). field-border itself computes 4.54/5.32:1. Status primitives claimed measured in shared tests; not re-run here.

states.evidence: No empty, loading or error captures.

responsive.evidence: 03-after-manifest overflow=0 at 390 and 1280 for all 16 captures; navigation reachable; target sizes not measured.

blockers: Phone Pages picker: first row at y~590; drop the in-picker 'Project Atlas' title/meta (the disclosure already names it) and the 'Quick Notes' label under the Quick Notes tab, compact the recovery notice to one line + link inside the picker, and align left edges to 16px so 6+ rows show.
styles.css:6 add select to 'button, input, textarea { font: inherit; }' so the footer notebook select uses Space.
Phone disclosures: chevrons instead of +/- (contract: section expanders use chevrons; '+' collides with the new-page '+').
Account avatar shows auth.user.id.slice(-2) ('hm') in Mono beside 'owner' (main.tsx:2866); use the username initial or drop it.
Desktop shows save state twice in green; keep one status voice (e.g. mute the meta timestamp to ink-muted).
Section tab: one selection treatment (drop the grey rounded top outline or the underline).
Contrast gate: move form input, .field select, .comment-compose input and .check-code-input borders to --ky-field-border.
path_to_8: Projected with the same anchors (not a promise): Pages picker without repeated notebook title/label, one-line notice and 16px edges -> h8 t8 d8 c8 a8 co8 = 8.0; select font + chevrons + avatar -> editor-mobile a8 co8 = 7.8, navigation a8 co8 = 8.0; compact desktop notice + one status voice + one tab treatment -> editor-desktop h8 d8 co8 = 8.0. Notes mean 7.95 -> 8.0 half-up, with no margin: every listed fix is needed. Editor-mobile density stays 7 because the canvas inset is stored coordinates (out of scope). The contrast fix is required for the gate, not the visual score.
